title: BLT debias used log(sum(exp(logprobs))) — silent underflow on small probabilities
root_cause: y_space_hat_all = log(einsum(exp(logprobs), space_mask).float()). exp() of low logprobs underflows to 0 in fp32, the masked sum collapses to 0, and log(0) = -inf is added into y_hat in-place. Subsequent loss terms silently propagate -inf values rather than failing.
invariant: All log-domain reductions should be performed via torch.logsumexp on a where-masked tensor instead of log(sum(exp(...))) over a multiplicative mask.
diff_summary: Replace torch.log(einsum(exp(...), mask)) with torch.where(mask, logprobs, -inf).logsumexp(-1); broadcast masks via [None, None, :].
silent_check: The first training step produces finite values for non-degenerate inputs; the issue only shows up when probabilities are small enough that exp underflows, producing -inf silently in metrics and downstream loss without raising.
